question.text: A set of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>20</mn></math> tuning forks is arranged in a series of increasing frequencies. If each fork gives <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn></math> beats with respect to the preceding fork and the frequency of the last fork is twice the frequency of the first, then the frequency of last fork is _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Hz</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Each fork produces 4 beats per second with the previous means each fork has frequency 4 Hz more than the previous.

Using relation, flast=ffirst+N-1x, here, N is the number of tuning fork in series and x is beat frequency between two successive forks.

2f0=f0+ 20-14

⇒2f0=f0+76⇒f0=76 Hz

Frequency of last tuning fork is 152 Hz.
